extraction_config.content:
Use your browser to collect a short University of Idaho research snapshot. Run entirely in Vandalizer chat, using browser_open and browser_read in the person's connected Chrome or Edge. Do not substitute web search, fetch_url or remembered facts for the browser.

Sites and figures
1. Open https://www.uidaho.edu/about/rankings-facts. Read the “U of I at a glance” section. Record the figure labelled “Annual research expenditures” with record_value, exactly as displayed, including its units. Also record the “Students” figure. If navigation or menus crowd out the section, use browser_read with query “Annual research expenditures”.
2. Open https://www.uidaho.edu/about/thinking-big/economic-impact. Read “R1 research fuels growth”. Use one record_value for the research expenditures figure, one for the research contribution to Gross State Product (GSP), and one for the jobs supported by research. Preserve words such as “nearly” and “over”. Use browser_read with query “R1 research fuels growth” if necessary.

Permission, sign-in and safety
Allow each site only when the person approves it. If a tool returns login_required or unapproved_site, stop and ask the person to open the working tab, sign in themselves if needed, return to Vandalizer and continue. Never ask for or type a password. Read the page again after they continue. Never submit, save, approve, pay or change anything on a website. If a tool refuses a control, report that and do not retry or bypass it.

Evidence and missing figures
Read each page this turn before recording its figures. Call record_value separately for every figure you report. Copy from the page; do not preload numbers from this Skill or your memory. If a label is missing or the page cannot be read, say Not found and explain which page was affected. Do not visit unrelated sites as a workaround.

Finish in chat
Return one concise table with columns Page, Figure, Recorded value, Period stated on page, and Source (a clickable link to the exact page). Say “Not stated” when a period is not given. Keep each period cell to the date or reporting period only. Put explanations about where it appears in a short note below the table. The two pages may describe different reporting periods or measures: keep them separate and do not present their difference as growth. Use calculate for any arithmetic the person requests, only after confirming the figures are comparable. End by identifying any missing figures and asking whether the person wants to adapt the Skill for their own portals.
